sage_polynomial_mode.description: Sage-parsable quotient-ring mode. Fill variables, quotient_ideal_generators, divisor_lifts, and integration_functional.top_monomial_values with the exact Esole-Yau Ewx resolved ambient Chow presentation. Set status to RESOLVED_AMBIENT_CHOW_DATA_VERIFIED only when complete.

integration_functional.description: Map normal-form top-degree monomials to exact rational integrals. Keys use Sage monomial syntax like R*H*H*Z or C1*C2*C3*C4 after normal-form reduction.

must_supply: full resolved ambient SR ideal generators in sage_polynomial_mode.quotient_ideal_generators or sr_ideal_generators
full resolved ambient linear-equivalence generators in sage_polynomial_mode.quotient_ideal_generators or linear_equivalence_generators
integration_functional.top_monomial_values sufficient for all normal forms or exceptional_intersection_values for all 1509 required monomials
